components.text_encoder: Qwen2_5_VLForConditionalGeneration: vision tower (32 blocks) + LM (28 layers, hidden 3584); the pipeline takes hidden_states[-1] and drops the 64 template tokens
components.transformer: QwenImageTransformer2DModel: 60 QwenImageTransformerBlock, 24 heads x 128, joint_attention_dim 3584, guidance_embeds false
components.vae: AutoencoderKLQwenImage: causal 3D conv encoder/decoder, z_dim 16, spatial /8

A_hf.task_heads_supported: a diffusers pipeline, not an AutoModel head: ONE task -- (image, edit instruction) -> edited image

published_example.source: diffusers.pipelines.qwenimage.pipeline_qwenimage_edit.QwenImageEditPipeline docstring example 1; seed from README.md example 1
published_example.prompt: Make Pikachu hold a sign that says 'Qwen Edit is awesome', yarn art style, detailed, vibrant colors
published_example.negative_prompt: not passed -> HF runs WITHOUT true CFG (do_true_cfg requires a negative prompt); true_cfg_scale is inert

A_hf.golden: QwenImageEditPipeline.__call__(image=[img]*n, prompt=[prompt]*n, num_inference_steps=50, generator=[torch.Generator().manual_seed(s) for s in seeds], output_type='pt') in float32 on CPU; stage tensors recorded (prompt_embeds, image_latents, every step's latents). reference/golden.py, cached in chunks of 4 seeds under reference/_golden/.

B_bringup.note: models/demos/qwen_image_edit holds the e2e package only. The model was brought up as three components; their folders ARE Source B.

dirs.vae: models/tt_dit/pipelines/qwen_image_edit_vae (graduated sharded: W over columns, batch over rows)

B_bringup.graduation_rule: bringup_status.json component with status NEW AND _stubs/<name>.py.last_good_native or .last_good_sharded present. REUSE/ADAPT entries are not graduated work products, even where they have a stub.
B_bringup.verification_2026_10_03: re-enumerated from the three bringup_status.json files with that rule: text_encoder 7 + transformer 7 + vae 11 = 25 graduated; every NEW entry has a snapshot (0 excluded). The list equals tt/tracker.py GRADUATED exactly, and Gate 2 asserts all 25 are counted.

vision_patch_embed.where: vision_encode, first op of the vision tower

vision_transformer_pretrained_model.where: vision_encode, the tower container composing the three above

language_model_layers_0_mlp.where: text_encode, the SwiGLU inside every LM layer

v_l_text_model.where: text_encode, the LM container (28 layers + final norm, row-staged on the 2-row mesh)

qwen_timestep_proj_embeddings.where: denoise, temb = container of the two above

qwen_embed_rope.where: denoise setup, the RoPE tables for (img_shapes, txt_len)

feed_forward.where: denoise, inside every block (image and text streams)

qwen_image_causal_conv3d.where: vae_encode + vae_decode (routed by the encoder/decoder ports)

helpers_not_graduated.tt/ glue (all ttnn): image-embedding splice, txt_norm RMSNorm, 2x2 latent pack/unpack, latent (de)normalisation, quant/post_quant 1x1x1 convs, FlowMatch Euler step, [0,1] image postprocess

task_heads.name: image_edit
task_heads.input: the published example verbatim for every sample (yarn-art-pikachu.png + its prompt, 50 steps), seeds 0..B-1 (sample 0 = seed 0 = the published run). Encoded on host exactly as QwenImageEditPipeline.__call__: VaeImageProcessor resize to calculate_dimensions(area) + preprocess, Qwen2VLProcessor over the prompt template, randn_tensor with one generator per sample, FlowMatch sigma table (tt/inputs.py).
task_heads.output: edited RGB image [B, 3, H, W] in [0, 1] (HF output_type='pt'); demo writes PNGs
chain: vision_encode: vision_transformer_pretrained_model(vision_patch_embed -> 32 x v_l_vision_block -> v_l_patch_merger) -> image embeddings

text_encode: token_embed(ids) with the image embeddings spliced over the <|image_pad|> run -> v_l_text_model (28 x v_l_decoder_layer, each calling language_model_layers_0_mlp; final norm) -> drop the 64 template tokens -> prompt_embeds

vae_encode: qwen_image_encoder3d (routes causal_conv3d / residual_block / r_m_s / resample + zero_pad2d / mid_block / attention_block) -> quant_conv -> mode -> (z - mean) / std -> 2x2 pack -> image_latents

denoise x 50 (the scheduler's own schedule): cat[latents, image_latents] -> img_in; txt_in(txt_norm(prompt_embeds)); temb = qwen_timestep_proj_embeddings(timesteps -> timestep_embedding)(t / 1000); rope = qwen_embed_rope(img_shapes, txt_len) -> 60 x qwen_image_transformer_block (feed_forward inside) -> ada_layer_norm_continuous -> proj_out -> v[:, :S] -> latents += (sigma_next - sigma) * v. No CFG (the example has no negative prompt). Steps 1..49 replay one captured device trace.

vae_decode: unpack -> z * std + mean -> post_quant_conv -> qwen_image_decoder3d (routes causal_conv3d / residual_block / r_m_s / mid_block / attention_block / up_block / resample + upsample) -> clamp -> (x + 1) / 2
task_heads.entry: tt/pipeline.py run_image_edit(pipe, enc) -- called by demo/demo_image_edit.py AND tests/e2e/test_e2e_image_edit.py (one wiring)
task_heads.ready_when: Gate 1 + Gate 2 + Gate 3 pass at B = $TT_PERF_BATCH = 32

pass_definition.gate1_native: static AST scan of every graduated stub module, the glue ports they route through and the tt/ chain finds no torch compute in forward code; AND host_op_observer sees zero host aten ops in the observed forward (uploaded encoded inputs -> image, every stage). Sharded bodies stay sharded (TP over the mesh), never rewritten to replication.
pass_definition.gate2_invoked: tt/tracker.py counts calls on the stub INSTANCES inside the chain during the real forward; all 25 graduated names must be > 0. No coverage sweep exists.
pass_definition.gate3_pcc: per-sample image PCC vs its own HF golden >= 0.99 for every one of the B=32 samples; `e2e PCC=<min>` printed on its own line before the asserts on every run.
pass_definition.horizon: the full 50-step schedule ran on both sides (asserted)
pass_definition.independence: each TT output matches its own golden best (argmax of the cross-PCC matrix) and outputs are not identical

validation_metric.primary: min over the 32 samples of PCC(tt_image[b], hf_image[b]) over the whole [3, H, W] image
validation_metric.diagnostic: per-stage min/mean PCC of prompt_embeds, image_latents and final latents vs the golden's recorded tensors (reported, not gated)
validation_metric.not_applicable: discrete-token exact agreement (no discrete output) and WER/MOS (not a rendered audio signal); the output is an image tensor

behavioral_proof.real_input: the HF example image + prompt through the HF processors; the output is the edited image, saved as PNG by the demo
behavioral_proof.no_injection: each stage consumes the previous TT stage's device tensor; golden tensors are read only for the comparison (and as fixed trace-setup inputs of the per-stage perf hooks, which are not the correctness path)
behavioral_proof.independence: 32 seeds -> 32 different initial noises -> 32 different edits; asserted distinct and own-golden-best

horizon.kind: diffusion; no autoregressive decode and no stop token
horizon.steps: num_inference_steps = 50 from the example; sigmas linspace(1, 1/50, 50) with dynamic shift mu(image_seq_len), identical on both sides; the full schedule runs and is asserted

resolution.area: 256 x 256 condition area on both sides (tt/inputs.py DEFAULT_AREA). HF hard-codes calculate_dimensions(1024*1024); the golden rebinds that one function to the gate's area. demo --area changes it.
resolution.why: the float32 CPU golden is ~10 s per sample-forward at 256^2; 32 samples x 50 steps at 1024^2 (~9.5k joint tokens) is ~140 h

batch.B: 32 = $TT_PERF_BATCH; the test reads it from the env and prints PERF_BATCH_STREAMS=B
batch.axis: leading axis of every tensor; one program per scheduler step for all B samples
batch.sourcing: content identical across samples (the published example); only the seed varies: sample i uses seed 0 + i
batch.ceilings: VAE encoder and decoder run 16 images per program (tt/vae.py encode_max_batch / decode_max_batch), measured 2026-09-28 (32 fails allocating in DRAM). Re-tested before finishing; see README / RUN_REPORT.

hardware.box: T3K, 8 x Wormhole (n300 x4), opened as a 2x4 mesh with FABRIC_1D
hardware.ceiling_used: 10.5 GB per chip (a CCL axis is in play)
hardware.per_chip_plan_GB: transformer TP=8 ~5.4 + text encoder TP=4 row-staged ~2.3 + VAE ~0.4 = ~8.1 GB weights, under 10.5 (the earlier 2026-09-23 measurement on this T3K; this run did not re-measure it)

split.text_encoder: TP=4 over the columns (graduated); LM row-staged: layers 0-13 on row 0, 14-27 on row 1
split.vae: W over the 4 columns, batch over the 2 rows (graduated)

trace_contract.derivation: model_index.json: text_encoder (Qwen2.5-VL: vision_config + text_config -> vision_encode, text_encode), vae (encode the condition image, decode the result), transformer (the step the scheduler repeats -> denoise)
trace_contract.per_stage: <stage>_trace_inputs / _trace_setup / _trace_step / _trace_items on the pipeline object; build_pipeline(device, model=None, layers=None, vision_encode_layers, text_encode_layers, denoise_layers) returns the object
trace_contract.stacks: visual.blocks (32), text_model.layers (28), transformer_blocks (60) as same-typed lists; the VAE stacks are heterogeneous levels and stay whole under a cap; the HF reference is reachable as pipe.hf
trace_contract.selftests: trace_capture_selftest (each stage captured, replayed, released; PCC vs eager) and host_op_selftest (forward under host_op_observer)

decisions.inputs: the published example verbatim, seeds 0..31; no authored prompts or images (the earlier 32-prompt set is retired)
decisions.no_cfg: the example passes no negative_prompt, so HF does not run true CFG; the TT side matches (one transformer call per step)
decisions.precision: every precise mode on: text encoder float32 + exact-lane LM products, transformer _precise (2-limb activations, exact-lane QK^T), VAE encoder float32 with exact-lane convs, quant/post_quant as exact-lane float32 matmuls; the text encoder's EXACT_MODE is set to 'guarded' by the pipeline (stub default unchanged)
